name: psp5min-v1
run: cd /work && python -m py_compile p5min.py test_p5min.py > /out/compile.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/compile.txt; sha256sum p5min.py test_p5min.py PREREG-v0.1.md | tee /out/sha256.txt; pip list 2>/dev/null | grep -iE '^(numpy|cdflib) ' | tee /out/versions.txt; exit $rc
cd /work && python -m unittest -v test_p5min > /out/tests.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/tests.txt; exit $rc

cd /work && python p5min.py --data-dir /data --out-dir /out --budget-s 15000 > /out/run.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; grep -E '^P5MIN_(VERSION|PERIHELIA|TIMECHECK|D[0-9]+_|GRADES|BUDGET|WARN)' /out/run.txt | head -n 200; tail -n 40 /out/run.txt; exit $rc
